misconception.myth: Higher foreign interest rates always strengthen that currency's forward exchange rate.
misconception.reality: Under Covered Interest Parity, the higher-yielding currency trades at a forward discount so total hedged returns equalize.

predictionQuestions.question: With UK rates at 8.0% above US rates at 5.0%, will the GBP forward trade at a premium or discount?

causalChain.condition: Quoted FX forward drifts away from Covered Interest Parity benchmark F0 = S0 exp((r - rf)T).
causalChain.action: Desks borrow domestic cash at rate r and convert into foreign spot currency at S0.
causalChain.mechanism: Foreign funds grow at risk-free rate rf while locked forward into domestic currency.
causalChain.result: Maturity proceeds settle the domestic loan obligation completely.
causalChain.consequence: Riskless currency arbitrage forces forward quotes back into interest parity.
